conditions: The 120-case/worker-stop start gate applies to NEW direct observer qualification or measurement work; existing authorized read-only initial-worker monitoring continues.

Snapshot historical process/admission/worker-stop inputs into immutable unit evidence before new process registration. Later appends to live process ledgers must not invalidate a frozen historical proof or substitute for the required current row membership. Never use a mutable live ledger as its own snapshot.

Same-process selected work holds and proves its own descriptor. Profiling parent holds and passes the descriptor; child must prove inherited descriptor/custody and process births before CUDA, or refuse. No busy-path inference or reacquisition.

Implement the separate direct binding/core tests in an isolated worktree first. Producer integration must use the reviewed shared observer interface after the A4500 producer is published; preserve both existing defaults and the fixed UVA policy.
Every actual context/UUID/PCI/proc/driver and occupancy/headroom sample is newly observed only on the approved UUID. Historical hardware is an expected constraint, not current proof.
Unsupported capacity, packing, final, scaling, other-device and portable consumers reject until separately supported and qualified.
